title: ホープフルSの後に・できた？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan achieves stellar results in the G1, and she's invited to her first press conference!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, nerves make her mind go completely blank, and she struggles to understand the questions. She leaves the affair wholly upset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frustrated, she hopes that her performance in the Satsuki Sho will make everyone realize how serious she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And, as it turns out, a reporter overhears her say that.
